problem_title: Breaking a flow into 2 different transactions
caption:
Breaking a flow into 2 different transactions

🔴 The Problem: IS there a way to break a single flow into 2 transactions? we have a really long flow that does a huge part of our business process, we are hitting governor limits due to the number of update/inserts/fastlookups etc. I am trying to break the transaction, some of the ways I found were To call an invocable method and call batch apex to recontinue the flow. Insert a wait element. as per docs . A transaction ends as...

✅ The Fix: Using a Wait (now called Pause ) element does preserve the Flow's state, including all of its variables and the field values of queried sObjects, across the boundary into a new transaction. As expected, limits are reset across the transaction boundary.
